_comment: A shipped sample layout, used by core's own tests to prove the window system parses and resolves roles. Deliberately generic: it belongs to no game. A layout is a tree of splits with a window at each leaf; POSITIONS are fixed here while SIZES belong to the player (dragged dividers, remembered in user://ui_layout.cfg). Variants are chosen at startup from the real viewport aspect - the best match is the highest min_aspect the viewport still satisfies. Roles a variant omits return null from CoreWindowRegistry, which is the contract that lets shared systems work on any screen.

variants._comment: Landscape: scene over prose on the left, party/status/log on the right.
Narrow or portrait: one column, prose given the most room, no map.
